sermon.title: Is God Aware of Your Situation?
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A short message from Exodus 3 and Hebrews 4: God has seen the oppression of His people, heard their cry and comes down to deliver them. Christ was tempted in all points as we are, so we can come boldly to the throne of grace and let God bring us out of darkness into His light.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. faqs.question: What three things does God say in Exodus 3?
faqs.answer: He has seen, He has heard, and He has come down to deliver.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And the LORD said: “I have surely seen the oppression of My people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows. So I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up from that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites.

faqs.question: What oppression can the kingdom of darkness bring?
faqs.answer: Oppression on your heart, or in your natural life.

faqs.question: Do you give God any time?
faqs.answer: He asks whether you take time to pray, come before Him, cry out and exalt Him.

faqs.question: What do people tell the speaker?
faqs.answer: That Mike has never been through what they have, like a gang member, an orphan or a family doing drugs; he says no, I don’t understand.

faqs.question: Can I meet God at home?
faqs.answer: Yes; you can come before Him at home in your time with God, but you have to come before Him.

faqs.question: How important are God’s people to Him?
faqs.answer: So important that the Creator and King of all kings steps down from His throne to deliver them.

faqs.question: Where is God when we worship?
faqs.answer: In our midst, like the Scripture says.
